not_understood.what: Disease state (DM1 patient versus control) for the samples
not_understood.why: The summary and title describe 3 DM1 patients and 3 controls, but the constant columns state source_name_ch1 'Control' and disease state 'control' for every sample, and the sample table lists only 3 samples (GSM1656433, GSM1656434, GSM1656435). No column varies with disease, so no state factor can be written from the metadata.
None is stated in the metadata; the only varying column, title, holds donor identifiers (ALS11, ALS13, ALS14), so it is read as the donor subject column and not as a factor.
